text:
alex: Perfetto trace shows occasional 30-50ms spikes in e2e latency. client->gateway spans look fine, but runtime span has a long gap around KV prefetch + kernel switch. perfetto link: perfetto://trace/abcd1234 (placeholder). Anyone seen batch 'splay' behaviour where small batches get interleaved causing kvcache misses?

maria: I've seen that when prefetch hits cause async memcpy + kernel launch that blocks kernel selection heuristic. Perfetto slice shows 'kv_prefetch' followed by 'select_kernel' with ~10ms gap.

jon: Can you paste the slice stack? Also which model variant and seq len?

alex: model: gpt-medium-8x, seq=512, quant=4bit. Perfetto snippet:
```
span runtime.start -> kv_prefetch (2.3ms)
  memcpy H2D (async) -> kernel_select wait (12.7ms)
  kernel_launch (fwd_attn_fp16_qkv)
```
I suspect batching heuristics put small requests behind prefetches, causing splay and tail latency.

perfbot: :robot_face: automated note: recent deploy 2026-03-15 changed batch_scheduler -> splay-enabled. Rollout at 30%. See release notes: https://internal/release/2026-03-15/batch-splay.

sam: That matches. splay spreads small requests across GPU but if prefetch isn't synchronized it creates head-of-line delays. Possible causes: 1) missing stream sync with prefetch 2) scheduler priority inversion 3) prefetch triggering kernel selection recompute.

lee: Repro steps I'd try: run an nsys capture with high concurrency and no sampling to see exact memcpy/kernel overlap:
```bash
nsys profile -o kvnomatch --trace=cuda,nvtx --capture-range=nvtx --sample=none \
  ./bench_client --parallelism=64 --seq=512 --model=gpt-medium-8x
```
Then export the cuda timeline and compare with perfetto gateway->runtime traces (enable NVTX annotations in runtime). Also run a gated scenario with splay disabled.

maria: If confirmed, quick mitigations: disable splay for seq>256, or make prefetch non-blocking on a separate CUDA stream + use cudaEvent to gate kernel selection instead of host-side wait. Long-term: add budget-aware prefetch that respects batch slot quotas.

alex: I'll kick off the nsys run and post the flame & perfetto link. If we see the memcpy+event ordering problem I'll open a small PR to gate splay by seq length and add a flag to the scheduler to prefer ready kernels over in-flight prefetches. Thanks — updating in thread when artifacts are uploaded.
